categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen Tungsten New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of new energy battery materials. Its main product lines include high-voltage lithium cobalt oxide (LCO), ternary materials (NCM/NCA), hydrogen energy materials, lithium iron phosphate (LFP), and sodium battery cathode materials. The company serves sectors such as 3C consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary technologies including high-voltage LCO synthesis, multi-element composite material co-precipitation, high-nickel cathode material synthesis, and solid-state hydrogen storage materials. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as co-precipitation for precursor materials, water-thermal synthesis for LFP, and innovative doping and coating techniques to enhance battery material performance. The company also focuses on developing next-generation materials like NL structured cathodes, solid-state electrolytes, and lithium supplementation additives.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international battery manufacturers serving 3C consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops, wearables), new energy vehicles (pure electric, hybrid, extended-range), and energy storage systems. The company maintains stable partnerships with major battery producers and automotive OEMs, supplying materials for high-end consumer electronics and various electric vehicle segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Xiamen, Ningde, Sanming, Ya'an, and Fuquan. It has expanded its global footprint with wholly-owned subsidiaries and joint ventures in Europe, including Germany and France, to serve international markets and support global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiamen Tungsten New Energy Materials operates upstream and midstream in the new energy battery supply chain, focusing on the production of cathode materials and hydrogen storage alloys. It collaborates closely with raw material suppliers and battery manufacturers, providing critical battery components but does not engage in battery assembly or end-product manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with significant R&D investment focused on enhancing energy density, safety, and performance of battery materials. Key R&D directions include high-voltage and high-nickel ternary cathodes, solid-state battery materials, sodium-ion battery cathodes, lithium supplementation additives, and hydrogen storage materials. It also emphasizes digital transformation, manufacturing optimization, and international expansion to sustain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of battery materials to large battery manufacturers and industrial clients. The company employs a cost-plus pricing model based on raw material costs plus processing fees, with customized production tailored to client specifications. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product sales and long-term supply contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically and globally in cobalt-based lithium battery cathode materials, especially high-voltage LCO where it is the market leader. It is among the top players in ternary cathode materials and hydrogen storage alloys. Competitors include other major Chinese and international battery material producers, but the company differentiates itself through advanced technology, product quality, and comprehensive product matrix.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 13.3 billion, a 23.19% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 494 million, down 6.33%. Despite revenue decline due to market conditions and raw material price drops, the company maintains a solid asset base of RMB 14.7 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D. It has a stable cash flow and a moderate net asset return of 5.73%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiamen Tungsten New Energy Materials emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, and high-quality product portfolio that delivers superior energy density, safety, and performance. Its differentiated products include high-voltage LCO, high-nickel and high-power ternary cathodes, and advanced hydrogen storage materials. The company also focuses on green manufacturing and low-carbon solutions, aligning with global sustainability trends to provide customers with innovative, reliable, and environmentally friendly battery materials.
